messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Elevated GPU queue times observed in us-west (pool: gpu-large). 80% of inference requests >500ms, intermittent 504s. Impacting a subset of customers. Monitoring alert: https://monitoring/redwood/alerts/2267890123

alex-m: I'm on it, grabbing the on-call. Initial looks like autoscaler hit quota and didn't provision new nodes. Kicking off manual scale-up now.

sara-k: Taking over oncall handoff from @alex-m. What are quick mitigations we can run while we dig into autoscaler?

alex-m: Quick mitigations: 
1) Manual scale: `kubectl scale deployment/gpu-large -n inference --replicas=12`
2) Shift non-critical traffic to eu-west via routing rule: `rbac route set region=eu-west --selector=traffic:noncritical`
3) Enable fallback model variant (quantized) for background jobs to reduce GPU pressure.

joanna: Manual scale issued, controller reports pods creating, ETA ~3m. I'll watch node come up.

ops-manager: Heads-up to support: please prepare messaging for impacted customers and note potential SLA impact. @cust-support can you draft? :loudspeaker:

cust-support: Drafting: "We're seeing increased inference latency in US-West. Engineers are scaling capacity; no data loss expected. We'll provide updates in 15-min intervals." Will publish after we confirm partial recovery.

sara-k: Scale helped, queue latency down ~45% but we still have hot-shard due to packing + token-heavy tails. Implementing temporary routing: divert 30% non-critical traffic to eu-west.

alex-m: Also flipping fallback to `gptx-small-quant` for low-priority lanes to free GPU cycles. Logging enabled for affected requests.

incident-bot: NOTE: Remediation ticket created RDW-4523 assigned to alex-m. Severity: Sev2. Due date: 2026-04-05. https://jira/redwood/RDW-4523

joanna: Follow-up action items I captured in the ticket: autoscaler min/max tuning, node pool boot latency investigation, quota alerting improvements. Assigning tentative owners: autoscaler config -> sara-k; node boot times -> joanna; quota alerts -> ops-manager.

ops-manager: Scheduling postmortem meeting — proposed: 2026-04-07 16:00 PST. Invite eng-runtime, eng-infra, support, product ops. Agendas: timeline, root cause, mitigation, short/medium term remedial plan, owner assignments.

sara-k: I will draft the postmortem doc and own the write-up. Will include timeline, customer impact table, and regression tests for autoscaler behavior.

cust-support: Once draft is ready, include a short customer-facing summary we can reuse for outreach.

alex-m: Preserving logs and artifacts: `/var/log/inference/2267890123-archive.tar.gz` and perf traces uploaded to S3: `s3://redwood-ops/incidents/2267890123/`

sara-k: Marking live mitigation closed. Tracking remaining remediation in RDW-4523. Owners to update the ticket with deliverables and ETA. :white_check_mark:

joanna: Final status: queues normalized, no active timeouts, monitoring returning to baseline. Closing incident thread for live ops. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
